paper_title: KuaiSearch: An E-Commerce Search Dataset with Authentic Queries and Product Texts for Recall, Ranking, and Relevance
reason: KuaiSearch는 Kuaishou 중국 이커머스 플랫폼의 실제 검색 로그로 만든 데이터셋이라 과제 언어가 중국어다. 근거는 Jieba 중국어 분절 사용, BM25의 중국어 단어 분절, 중국어용 BGE-base-zh 임베딩 사용, 부록 표 10의 중국어 질의·상품명 예시, 한계 절의 '중국 이커머스 플랫폼' 및 '중국어 표현' 언급이다. 한국어 또는 영어 과제 데이터는 제공되지 않으며, 번역은 한계 절에서 향후 과제로만 언급된다. 따라서 ko/en 트랙 어디에도 맞지 않아 인벤토리 범위 밖으로 제외한다.

screening.paper_title: KuaiSearch: An E-Commerce Search Dataset with Authentic Queries and Product Texts for Recall, Ranking, and Relevance
screening.abstract: E-commerce search connects user needs with massive product inventories, yet real-world systems face challenges from ambiguous queries, noisy product texts, and diverse user preferences. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) offer new opportunities for semantic understanding and intent modeling, but existing e-commerce search datasets remain limited by heuristically constructed queries, popularity-based filtering, anonymized texts, and incomplete coverage of the search pipeline. These limitations hinder realistic evaluation of LLM-based e-commerce search. To address this gap, we introduce KuaiSearch, a large-scale dataset built from real user search interactions on the Kuaishou platform. KuaiSearch preserves authentic queries and natural-language product texts, retains cold-start users and long-tail products, and covers three key stages of the search pipeline: recall, ranking, and relevance judgment. We further provide comprehensive analyses of users, products, and queries, together with benchmark experiments on representative search tasks. Results demonstrate the value of KuaiSearch as a realistic benchmark for e-commerce search research. The code is available at https://github.com/benchen4395/KuaiSearch.
